description:
Otaku Yoon Jaewoo discovers a new favorite character while playing a newly released game. Not long after, he meets someone who looks exactly like that character—except this version is flat-chested and, surprisingly, male!

To make things even more complicated, the look-alike turns out to be a freshman at the same university. Despite knowing he’s a guy, Jaewoo can’t resist that familiar face. So when the look-alike confesses that he’s liked him for a while, Jaewoo impulsively says yes…
